name: 21st
summary: Community registry of 12,000+ React and Tailwind components, templates and themes, installable by copy, shadcn CLI, MCP or API.
description: A community catalog and shadcn-format registry of React, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript components, component libraries, templates, themes and icons. Items preview live and can be copied as TSX, installed with the shadcn CLI from their registry URL, or pulled into coding agents through the 21st MCP server and CLI; 21st AI generates new components from prompts. Free browsing with a small daily retrieval quota, paid Builder and Team plans remove the limits.
contains: 12,000+ React and Tailwind components, templates and themes
copy the TSX, install via the shadcn CLI registry URL, or pull through the 21st MCP
21st AI generates components from a prompt; REST API with OpenAPI spec
free tier: browse and 2 code retrievals per day
Builder and Team plans add unlimited installs and AI credits
markdown twins and agent discovery endpoints; icons, themes and templates
